mapper.select: SELECT daily_statistics.statistics_date AS date, daily_statistics.total_order_count, daily_statistics.completed_order_count, daily_statistics.canceled_order_count, daily_statistics.total_sales_amount FROM daily_statistics WHERE daily_statistics.statistics_date >= #{startDate} AND daily_statistics.statistics_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY daily_statistics.statistics_date

SELECT DATEDIFF(#{endDate}, #{startDate}) + 1 - COUNT(CASE WHEN daily_statistics.product_aggregated_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) FROM daily_statistics WHERE daily_statistics.statistics_date >= #{startDate} AND daily_statistics.statistics_date <= #{endDate}

WITH ranked_product_name AS ( SELECT daily_product_statistics.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY daily_product_statistics.product_id ORDER BY daily_product_statistics.statistics_date DESC ) AS product_name_rank FROM daily_product_statistics WHERE daily_product_statistics.statistics_date >= #{startDate} AND daily_product_statistics.statistics_date <= #{endDate} ), aggregated_product_statistics AS ( SELECT ranked_product_name.product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN ranked_product_name.product_name_rank = 1 THEN ranked_product_name.product_name ELSE NULL END) AS product_name, SUM(ranked_product_name.order_count) AS order_count, SUM(ranked_product_name.sales_quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(ranked_product_name.sales_amount) AS sales_amount FROM ranked_product_name GROUP BY ranked_product_name.product_id ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY aggregated_product_statistics.sales_amount DESC, aggregated_product_statistics.sales_quantity DESC, aggregated_product_statistics.order_count DESC, aggregated_product_statistics.product_id ) AS ranking, aggregated_product_statistics.product_id, aggregated_product_statistics.product_name, aggregated_product_statistics.order_count, aggregated_product_statistics.sales_quantity, aggregated_product_statistics.sales_amount FROM aggregated_product_statistics ORDER BY ranking

WITH backfill_start AS ( SELECT MIN(statistics_batch_run.target_start_date) AS start_date FROM statistics_batch_runs AS statistics_batch_run WHERE statistics_batch_run.batch_type = 'BACKFILL' ), numbered_statistics AS ( SELECT daily_statistics.statistics_date, backfill_start.start_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY daily_statistics.statistics_date ) AS sequence_number FROM daily_statistics JOIN backfill_start ON backfill_start.start_date IS NOT NULL WHERE daily_statistics.statistics_date >= backfill_start.start_date AND daily_statistics.statistics_date <= #{latestStatisticsDate} ) SELECT MAX(numbered_statistics.statistics_date) FROM numbered_statistics WHERE DATEDIFF( numbered_statistics.statistics_date, numbered_statistics.start_date ) = numbered_statistics.sequence_number - 1
